theme: Tuning a network so it rings at the right pitch
title: Spectral Tuning: Placing a Network's Ringing Frequencies
strategies: uniform stiffness: midpoint of every edge's weight range, ignore the target spectrum
per-eigenvalue independent hill climbing: repeatedly find the single worst eigenvalue and nudge the edge most sensitive to it alone

coupled Gauss-Newton on the exact eigenvalue-perturbation Jacobian: solve a damped joint least-squares system across all target eigenvalues at once, exploiting rank-1 interlacing to move weights in the order-respecting direction
global trace-matching plus local reshaping: fix sum(lambda_i)=2*sum(w_e) exactly first, then redistribute weight among edges
